ops.issue: Three errors: 君を is the object of 捕まえる, not a topic ('As for you' is wrong); 捕まえ means 'catch/arrest', not 'fetch (it)'; and のではない is a clause negation, but 'isn't that right' renders it as an agreement tag, flipping the denial into an affirmation.

'Quanto a você' misreads the object marker を as topic (the item's own expl says 君 is the object); and 'vim, não é (assim), viu' reads as a tag question ('né?'), while のではない negates the whole clause ('não é que eu tenha vindo...').

The rewrite introduces an em dash into learner-facing text: "You (obj.), to catch, (I) came — it is not the case, you know." The project style bans em dashes; the before-text had none. The fix itself (object marking, 'catch', negation of the whole clause) is correct, only the punctuation is new breakage.
Same newly introduced em dash in pt-BR: "Você (obj.), para capturar, vim — não é o caso, viu." Em dashes are banned in this corpus's learner-facing text and none existed in 'before'.

ops.issue: Logically inverted literal: 'the only thing I didn't do was play' means he did everything EXCEPT play games; しか + negative means he did NOTHING BUT play games. The parenthetical shows the intended meaning, but the mirror itself states the opposite.

structure_explanation.en: The topic is 今日 (today), marked by は. The core structure is ゲームしかしなかった: the particle しか ('only / just') combined with the verb in the NEGATIVE form (しなかった = didn't do) means 'I only did X / nothing but X'. Don't confuse it with the connective しかし ('however'): here we have the particle しか + the verb した in the negative, which by coincidence forms the syllable sequence 'しか し', but it is a completely different construction.
